description: Main application entry point for a Flutter-based newspaper/news reader app. Sets up environment configuration, database initialization, and dependency injection with providers, and manages app startup and error/loading states.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root stateful widget that hosts the entire app, manages initialization of database and provides global app state.

classes.name: _MyAppState
classes.description: State class for MyApp, handles database setup, initialization, and widget building with loading/error handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes Flutter, loads environment configuration, and runs the app.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes database and startup future in the app's state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree depending on initialization state, showing loading, error, or the main app with providers.
